rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The evidence base for advancing comparative lot/formulation studies or intranasal bridging is insufficient. Only the MISEV2023 guidance was provided; there is low confidence that program-specific, submission-grade CMC and intact-EV analytics exist for SGL-001.
findings: The supplied evidence set includes only the MISEV2023 quality-framework (ev-misev2023-quality-framework); no program-specific CMC, validation, batch, stability, potency, or biodistribution datasets were provided.

MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal intact-EV characterization, validated intact-EV assays (with LLOQ, specificity, precision), transparent production reporting, and appropriate controls for biodistribution interpretation, but is guidance—not program-specific proof that SGL-001 meets these requirements.

Critical submission-grade artifacts are missing: MCB/WCB characterization documents, fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV release assays, validated intact-EV biodistribution/quantitation assays, a stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint, and comparability data from ≥3 GMP-like batches.
objections: The program is proceeding toward comparative lot/formulation and intranasal bridging studies without any program-specific, submission-grade CMC and analytics evidence that would attribute in vivo signals to intact EV and demonstrate reproducible potency across lots; MISEV2023 supports what must be done but is not evidence that it has been done for SGL-001.

claim_updates.rationale: Only the MISEV2023 guidance was provided; no program-specific submission-grade artifacts were supplied to support this claim.
claim_updates.statement: Submission-grade intact-EV CMC and analytics artifacts (MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV release assays, stability-indicating potency assay correlated to in vivo PD, and ≥3 GMP-like batch comparability) exist for SGL-001.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV outlines reporting expectations, but no MCB/WCB creation/characterization, process scale-up/validation, or GMP-like batch data were provided.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 source-cell MCB/WCB and scalable, reproducible production have been demonstrated to submission standards.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV recommends validated intact-EV-specific analytics and controls before interpreting biodistribution; no validated intact-EV biodistribution assays, appropriate controls, or larger-species bridging data were provided, so cross-species predictivity is unsupported.
claim_updates.statement: Existing rodent intranasal biodistribution/efficacy data for SGL-001 reliably predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species.

decision_update.question: Is the Stage-1 package sufficient to proceed with comparative lot/formulation and intranasal bridging studies?
decision_update.rationale: Current materials are insufficient. Require Stage-1 CMC/analytics package (MCB/WCB docs; validated intact-EV release and biodistribution assays; stability-indicating potency assay correlated to in vivo PD; ≥3 GMP-like batch comparability) and independent review before permitting comparative or bridging studies.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) is a methodological guidance document and does not substitute for program-specific, submission-grade CMC, assay validation, batch, stability, potency, or biodistribution data for SGL-001.

hypothesis_update.rationale: These elements are necessary to attribute in vivo signals to intact EV, ensure consistent product identity/potency, and meet regulatory expectations for advancing biodistribution bridging studies.
hypothesis_update.statement: Advancement to comparative lot/formulation and intranasal bridging requires validated intact-EV analytics, submission-grade MCB/WCB documentation, a stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint, and reproducible comparability across ≥3 GMP-like batches.
hypothesis_update.test_plan: Require submission of Stage-1 package items and independent review of assay validation reports and GMP-like batch comparability; success criterion = submission-grade documentation meeting predefined acceptance criteria.

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble Stage-1 CMC/analytics package and retrieve targeted records: 1) MCB/WCB characterization (identity, adventitious agent testing, stability, storage); 2) Fit-for-purpose validation reports for orthogonal QC and intact-EV release assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, robustness); 3) Stability study reports and stability-indicating potency assay development with correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; 4) Manufacturing and comparability data from ≥3 GMP-like batches (release results, CQA trending, stability, potency); 5) Validated intact-EV biodistribution/quantitation assay reports and GLP intranasal biodistribution/tox bridging study plan/data in a larger species using those assays and controls. Prepare these materials for regulatory/scientific advice meetings.

risk_updates.mitigation: Develop and validate intact-EV-specific biodistribution assays, include positive/negative controls, and conduct GLP bridging studies in a larger species using validated analytics.
risk_updates.title: Cross-species intranasal CNS delivery uncertainty

risk_updates.mitigation: Assemble Stage-1 CMC package, validate orthogonal QC panel and potency assays, generate ≥3 GMP-like batches with head-to-head comparability analyses.
risk_updates.title: CMC: identity, potency, and batch comparability gap

risk_updates.description: Lack of validated potency and biodistribution assays undermines the ability to link in vitro or rodent PD endpoints to human-relevant efficacy predictions.
risk_updates.mitigation: Develop stability-indicating potency assays correlated to in vivo PD; perform bridging studies that include PD endpoints in larger species where feasible.
risk_updates.title: Efficacy model generalizability

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not proceed with comparative lot/formulation studies or intranasal bridging in larger species until a Stage-1 CMC/analytics package is assembled and reviewed. This package must include: (1) MCB and WCB characterization documents meeting regulatory expectations; (2) validated orthogonal release and intact-EV assays (LLOQ, specificity vs non-vesicular particles, accuracy, intra/inter-assay precision, robustness); (3) a stability-indicating potency assay with evidence of correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; (4) manufacturing/comparability data from ≥3 GMP-like batches (release, stability, potency, comparability analyses); and (5) validated intact-EV biodistribution assays and a GLP intranasal biodistribution/toxicology bridging study in a larger species using those assays with appropriate positive/negative controls. Prepare the Stage-1 package for a regulatory pre-IND/scientific advice briefing in two jurisdictions. Require human approval before any major therapeutic advancement decision.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Evidence gap / Unsupported: The MISEV2023 consensus (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) documents recommended best practices for orthogonal EV characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, and controls for functional studies. However, the supplied evidence does not include program-specific, submission-grade CMC artifacts (MCB/WCB records; validated intact-EV release assays with LLOQ/specificity/precision; stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint; comparability across ≥3 GMP-like batches). Therefore, while MISEV supports the need for an orthogonal QC panel and validated assays, the available evidence does not demonstrate that those prerequisites have been met for SGL-001.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program lacks submission-grade CMC artifacts: MCB/WCB records, fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV release assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision), stability-indicating potency assay development and correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint, and reproducible release/stability/potency across ≥3 GMP-like batches.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) outlines necessary reporting elements (including defined source-cell characterization and production reporting). The supplied evidence set does not contain program-specific manufacturing/scale-up data, MCB/WCB creation/characterization reports, or comparability data from multiple GMP-like batches. As such, there is insufficient evidence to accept the claim that current materials demonstrate a characterized MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production for SGL-001.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: No manufacturing/scale-up data, no MCB/WCB evidence, and no release/stability comparability across multiple batches in the provided evidence set.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Partial support but with important evidence gaps / Unsupported for program-specific translation claims: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the methodological need for orthogonal intact-EV analytics and rigorous controls before interpreting in vivo biodistribution. That guidance does not, however, provide program-specific biodistribution or cross-species translational data. The supplied evidence does not include validated intact-EV-specific biodistribution assays, appropriate positive/negative controls demonstrating signal is from intact vesicles, nor larger-species intranasal biodistribution/tox studies for SGL-001. Therefore, while the methodological recommendation is supported, the available evidence is insufficient to conclude that rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL-001 are adequate predictors of intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Absence of intact-EV-specific biodistribution assays (demonstrating signal is from intact vesicles), negative/positive controls, and larger-species intranasal biodistribution/tox studies in the supplied evidence.
